issues.what: Stem does not specify policyTypes but correct answer depends on policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
issues.detail: Stem describes a NetworkPolicy with only ingress rules and says egress is blocked, but does not mention policyTypes. Per K8s docs, if policyTypes is omitted, only Ingress is inferred and egress would NOT be blocked.
issues.suggestion: Add policyTypes to the stem: 'A NetworkPolicy with policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress] that allows ingress to pods labeled app: db only from pods labeled app: api on port 5432.'
